english.text: Little is known about his early life, except that he was born in Venice, grew up there, and when he was fifteen years old, he met his father Niccolò and his uncle Maffeo who were returning from their journey. They also witnessed the death of Pope Clement IV, waiting until the election of the new pope. In the year 1271, they once again took the road to the Mongol Empire, and this time the young Marco, who was then seventeen years old, accompanied them.

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: These days, I am wearing my red touque with orange letters in Tagalog, "MGA AWSTRALYA ANG MGA ESTRELYA," alluding to space colonization and the cold and hot deserts of other worlds. These days, I talk with Greg, my religious Filipino friend, at Starbucks café. We talk about travelling, anthropology, international food, and religion. This morning, I played in the midst of dense fog in a neighbourhood grassy field. At Starbucks café, in the foggy morning, I was drinking my reddish Passion Tango iced tea, which contained hibiscus, lemongrass, cinnamon, passion fruit, pineapple, and so forth. Greg gifted me a chocolate croissant. At Starbucks café, in the grey-sky afternoon, I was drinking the seasonal Oat Nog Latte. (Incidentally, Nog is a dwarf-like Ferengi alien character in the Star Trek franchise.) Kristina, part-Inuit part-Norwegian, was my barista. She has a handsome face, and her mannerisms and style reflect some things about her Inuit ancestors. "Viktor, it's like you're part-Inuit," she told me. She knows that I am from the Philippines. At my table, I exercised with my hand grip strengthener, which I carried in my army jacket pocket. At the café, I greeted Don the alluring white man and Květa the solitary Czech lady, as I exited. It is the 4th of December of 2024.

text: 呢幾日，我戴住我嘅紅色頭巾，上面用塔加洛文寫住橙色字母，「MGA AWSTRALYA ANG MGA ESTRELYA」，暗示太空殖民同其他世界嘅冷熱沙漠。呢幾日，我喺星巴克咖啡館同我嘅宗教菲律賓朋友 Greg 傾偈。我哋講旅行、人類學、國際美食同宗教。 今朝，我喺一個鄰近嘅草地上，喺濃霧中玩。喺星巴克咖啡館，喺霧霾嘅朝早，我飲緊我嘅紅色 Passion Tango 冰茶，入面有芙蓉、香茅、肉桂、熱情果、菠蘿等等。 Greg 送咗個朱古力牛角包畀我。係星巴克咖啡廳，喺灰暗嘅下午，我飲緊季節性嘅燕麥拿鐵。 （順帶一提，諾格係《星際迷航》系列入面一個好似矮人噉嘅費倫吉外星人角色。）克里斯蒂娜，一半係伊努伊特人，一半係挪威人，係我嘅咖啡師。佢有個靚仔嘅臉，而佢嘅舉止同風格反映咗佢嘅伊努伊特祖先嘅一啲嘢。 「 Viktor ，你好似係部分因紐特人噉，」佢同我講。佢知道我係菲律賓人。喺我張檯度，我用我嘅手握加強器做運動，我將佢放喺我件軍褸個袋度。喺咖啡廳，我離開嗰陣同誘人嘅白人 Don 同孤獨嘅捷克女士 Květa 打招呼。今日係2024年12月4號。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It's Lulu Island, the 26th of July of 2025. It begins as always—with sunlight glinting off sidewalks and the easy rhythm of habit. I walk to Tim Hortons, a modern pilgrimage. The oat-milk coffee, a small rite. Gary is there again—Gary the Cantonese, as I've come to call him in my inner haiku. We talk over steaming cups and breakfast sandwiches, meandering from Japan to Thailand to the war. I tell him: "One week Tokyo, one week Okinawa." He nods. We agree: the taste of a place is its soul. We smile at the thought of izakaya clamor and the smell of fish sauce. Then history unfolds like an old film reel. In the Philippines, my mother—a child—was given a toy chick by a Japanese soldier, who spoke of returning, of marriage. Gary speaks of rivers crossed under fear, in "Occupied Hong Kong" in the shadow of Empire. We don't mention everything. I don't mention my alternate histories—the Dai Tōa Kyōeiken, shimmering in some parallel world. The unspoken sometimes speaks loudest. Yesterday, the forest of South Arm Park. I wandered there in contemplative silence. A lone ice cream truck rolled by, blaring "Music Box Dancer"—a tune too cheerful for the tangle of emotion in my chest. / ice cream melody— / childhood ghosts stirring / in the shade of firs

text: 呢個係2025年7月26號嘅露露島。佢一如既往噉開始 — — 陽光喺人行道上閃閃發光，同埋習慣嘅輕鬆節奏。 我行去蒂姆霍頓，一個現代朝聖。 燕麥奶咖啡，一個小儀式。 Gary 又喺返度 — 香港人 Gary ，我喺我內心嘅俳句入面叫佢嘅名。 我哋喺蒸杯同早餐三文治嘅時候傾偈，由日本到泰國再到戰爭。 我同佢講：「一個禮拜東京，一個禮拜沖繩。」 佢點頭。 我哋同意：一個地方嘅味道就係佢嘅靈魂。 諗起居酒屋嘅喧囂同魚露嘅香味，我哋都會笑。 然後歷史就好似舊電影卷軸噉展開。 喺菲律賓，我阿媽 — 一個小朋友 — 由一個日本士兵送咗隻玩具小雞畀佢，佢講到返嚟，講到結婚。 Gary喺《被佔領嘅香港》入面，喺帝國嘅陰影下，講到喺恐懼之下渡過嘅河流。 我哋唔會提所有嘢。 我唔提我嘅替代歷史 — 大東亞京英拳，喺某個平行世界入面閃閃發光。 未講嘅人有時會講得最大聲。 琴日，南臂公園嘅森林。 我喺嗰度沉思嘅沉默入面漫緊步。 一架孤獨嘅雪糕車滾過嚟，喊住「音樂盒舞者」 — — 呢首歌對我胸口嘅情緒糾纏嚟講太開朗喇。 / 雪糕旋律 — / 童年鬼魂攪動 / 喺木杉嘅陰影下

english.text: The Algerian constitution is translated into modern Berber, not a local dialect commonly referred to as Kabyle. In fact, modern Berber is based on a commonly spoken Berber dialect enhanced with a consensual modern terminology, while Kabyle, as a dialect, has unfortunately become some sort of pidgin or a hodgepodge of a couple Berber words mixed with countless French and Arabic words.

text: 阿爾及利亞憲法係翻譯成現代嘅柏柏爾文，而唔係一種通常稱為卡比勒文嘅當地方言。事實上，現代嘅柏柏爾人係基於一種常見嘅柏柏爾方言，並加入咗一個共識嘅現代術語，而卡比爾作為一種方言，不幸噉已經變成某種洋涇浜語或者係一兩個柏柏爾語詞混合咗無數法文同阿拉伯語詞嘅大雜物。
